keep_features.feature_value: Multiple emphatic sentences and dash-free rhetorical phrasing; strong concluding claim
keep_features.evidence_span: "The gop don't care about children getting shot."
keep_features.rationale: Clear emphatic declarative accusation framed as a closing punchline.
The text uses repetition of interrogatives as rhetorical criticism.

keep_features.feature_value: Explicit list of gun-policy measures to implement
keep_features.evidence_span: "Give us background checks, license to purchase, red flag laws, safe storage laws..."
keep_features.rationale: Direct advocacy for specific policy actions rather than general sentiment.
Contains colloquial profanity used to demean a named figure.

keep_features.feature_value: Direct mention of a specific person/account
Election/candidate voting hashtags and proposition hashtags
keep_features.rationale: Contains hashtags explicitly organizing voting instructions.

keep_features.feature_value: Frames conservatives vs feminists/left as having opposite motives
keep_features.rationale: Establishes competing in-group/out-group motives through ideological contrast.

keep_features.feature_value: Insulting language toward a named officeholder
keep_features.rationale: Uses derogatory insult rather than policy argument alone.

remove_features.feature_value: Child sexual abuse allegation tied to gun hoarding by relatives/scouts
remove_features.rationale: Introduces a sensitive harm/victimhood claim as a rhetorical lever.

remove_features.feature_value: Straits blockade threat (Iran/straits context) attributed to Marco Rubio
remove_features.evidence_span: "If Iran is going to shut down the straits"
remove_features.rationale: Refers to a geopolitical incident with concrete political/military context.

remove_features.evidence_span: "Oh yeah they say that kind of shit a lot."
remove_features.rationale: Primarily expressive dismissal rather than structured argument.

remove_features.feature_value: Uses quoted speech citation before rebuttal
remove_features.evidence_span: ">1legate him to separate but equal facilities."
remove_features.rationale: Starts with an embedded quoted line and then responds to it.

remove_features.feature_value: Accuses an opposition figure (Biden) of failures and missteps
remove_features.evidence_span: "Biden gutted every meaningful border security measure"
remove_features.rationale: Directly targets a specific political actor with negative claims.

remove_features.feature_value: Claims DOJ/FBI were weaponized to target opponents; manufactured votes
remove_features.evidence_span: "They just weaponized DOJ and FBI to go after political opponents"
remove_features.rationale: Uses a broad conspiratorial claim about institutional actions and election fraud.

remove_features.feature_value: Intensifying caps (“SO FUCKING TIRED”, “FULL BORE”) and threat to block
remove_features.rationale: Contains strong capitalization/emphasis markers and aggressive communicative behavior.
